title: Vibe code is legacy code
summary: Argues that vibe-coded software nobody understands is instant legacy code: fine for throwaway prototypes, a debt trap for maintained projects.

assertions.quote: vibe coding is perfect for prototypes and throwaway projects: It's only legacy code if you have to maintain it!
When you vibe code, you are incurring tech debt as fast as the LLM can spit it out.
Programming is fundamentally theory building, not producing lines of code.
They're going to have to learn to use their human eyes to read the code
I was able to vibe code these apps way faster than I could've built them, and it was a blast.
sometimes it's easier to start over with building a well-written code base from scratch than to fix a legacy one that nobody understands
